display.purpose: h1-h4 headings only — hero headline, section titles, card/modal titles.

body.purpose: All running copy, form labels, table content, buttons.

label.purpose: Metadata, stat-card eyebrows, table headers, status chips.

shadows.name: ambient
shadows.purpose: Default resting shadow for every card, table container, and stat tile.

shadows.name: signature-glow
shadows.purpose: Reserved for the single primary CTA per screen — colored, brand-tinted glow.

motion.name: color-transition
motion.purpose: Default hover/focus transition for every interactive surface — never abrupt.

motion.name: lift-transition
motion.purpose: Subtle -translate-y on hover for elevated primary actions (e.g. the WhatsApp registration CTA).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The system's one true call-to-action shape — a full pill, used for the single most important action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #15803d; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.125rem; padding: 14px 32px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -5px rgba(22,163,74,0.2); transition: background-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #166534; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #16a34a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Utility/cancel action — never competes visually with a primary button on the same screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #57534e; font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid #d6d3d1; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #fafaf9; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #16a34a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The default content container — Sage Whisper border, Ambient shadow, generous rounding.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #dcfce7; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); padding: 24px; } .ds-card-eyebrow { font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #78716c; margin: 0 0 4px; } .ds-card-value { font-family: 'Baloo 2', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.25rem; color: #166534; margin: 0; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text input at rest and on focus — border color is the only focus signal, no glow or ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: #292524; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #d6d3d1; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; transition: border-color 0.2s ease; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #a8a29e; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #15803d; }

components.name: Nav Item (Active)
components.description: Sidebar navigation item in its active state — a filled pill on the dark green rail.
components.html: Dashboard
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; width: 80px; padding: 12px 0; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #bbf7d0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #166534; color: #ffffff; } .ds-nav-item--active { background: #15803d; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Small status/count indicator — reuses the accent colors strictly for their functional meaning (here, warning/urgent).
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 16px; height: 16px; padding: 0 4px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.625rem; color: #ffffff; } .ds-badge--warning { background: #f59e0b; } .ds-badge--alert { background: #e11d48; } .ds-badge--info { background: #0369a1; }

narrative.overview: Ihsanify reads as a place things are grown, not manufactured — a warm, patient, green-forward system built for parents deciding whether to trust their child's Quran education to this school, and for the teachers and staff who tend that education every day afterward. The palette is dominated by a single deep, muted green used with restraint against generous white and warm-stone space; nothing shouts, because trust isn't built by shouting. Corners are soft everywhere — pills for primary actions, gently rounded cards for content — and the system stays almost entirely flat, saving its one moment of visual drama (a soft colored glow) for the single most important action on a screen. Baloo 2's rounded, friendly letterforms carry every heading; Nunito carries everything you actually read.
keyCharacteristics: Deep sage green as the singular brand signal — never diluted by a second competing hue
Warm stone (not cool gray) for all neutral text and structure
Flat-by-default surfaces; depth is earned, not decorative
Generously rounded corners throughout — pills for action, soft rectangles for content
Small, purposeful accent colors (rose, amber, sky) reserved strictly for status, never decoration

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Deep Sage Trust is the only color allowed to carry brand meaning. Every other hue (rose, amber, sky) is a status signal, never a decorative choice.

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: Neutrals are always Stone, never Gray. Treat any gray-* class found in the codebase as a defect to fix, not a variant to preserve.

rules.name: The Heading-Font Discipline Rule
rules.body: Baloo 2 is reserved for h1-h4 and nothing else — buttons, badges, and body copy stay in Nunito even when bold.

rules.name: The One Glow Rule
rules.body: Only one element per screen may carry the Signature Glow shadow. Two competing glows is a hierarchy problem, not a style choice.

dos: Do keep Deep Sage Trust as the only color that carries brand/identity meaning.
Do use the Signature Glow shadow on exactly one primary action per screen, never more.
Do default every card to rounded-2xl with a Sage Whisper border and Ambient shadow.
Do keep Baloo 2 confined to headings; everything else stays in Nunito.
Do reserve rounded-full specifically for primary/urgent actions.
donts: Don't introduce Tailwind's Gray palette for neutrals — Stone is the only neutral family.
Don't add a second brand-feeling accent color alongside Deep Sage Trust.
Don't stack shadows or elevate more than one element per screen.
Don't sharpen corners on primary actions or structural containers.
